name: Kayla Raniwsky
playingHistory: Southwest Wildcats, 2008-09 to 2010-11. Led the team with 26 goals and 42 points in 36 games in 2010-11.
Niagara University (NCAA Division I), 2011-12. CHA All-Rookie Team.
St. Lawrence University (NCAA Division I), 2012-13 to 2014-15.

name: Jess Hitchcock
playingHistory: Windsor Wildcats, 2006-07 and 2007-08.
Southwest Wildcats, 2008-09 and 2009-10, team captain.
Niagara University (NCAA Division I), 2010-11 and 2011-12.

name: Kiera Ruddy (Jackson)
playingHistory: Southwest Wildcats alumna (PWHL, now OWHL U22 Elite).
University of Windsor Lancers Track & Field (2018–2022): sprints, relays, and combined events.
OUA bronze medallist and ranked among the Windsor Lancers’ all-time top 10 women’s track and field performances.
Four-time U SPORTS Academic All-Canadian.
Ed Lumley Scholarship and Jerry Slavic Award recipient.
Windsor Lancers Captains’ Trophy nominee.
bio: Kiera’s coaching philosophy emphasizes hard work, discipline, and accountability. She believes in encouraging athletes to take ownership of their development, find motivation, and approach challenges with a willingness to learn and improve.
tagline: Wildcats Alum · U SPORTS Track & Field

name: Chays Ruddy
playingHistory: Junior hockey: Port Hope Panthers (PJHL), Trenton Golden Hawks (OJHL), and Prince George Spruce Kings (BCHL).
OJHL champion with the Trenton Golden Hawks (2015/16, 2016/17).
OJHL League Fan Favourite Award (2016/17).
BCHL Top Defenceman, Iron Man, and Fan Favourite Awards (2017/18).
University of Windsor Lancers Men’s Hockey (2018–2020), U SPORTS.
Professional hockey: ECHL (Fort Wayne, Kansas City, Cincinnati, Toledo, Orlando); EIHL (Manchester Storm, UK).
2023/24 Rob Kenny Memorial Award recipient, Orlando Solar Bears (ECHL), recognizing outstanding commitment to community service.
Tilbury Bluebirds (NPHL), 2025–present.
bio: Chays draws on his experience across junior, university, and professional hockey to bring a knowledgeable and demanding approach to coaching. Having competed at multiple levels, he understands the work ethic, discipline, and accountability required to succeed. He emphasizes high expectations while adapting his coaching to individual skill levels, challenging athletes to develop, improve, and reach their potential.
tagline: U SPORTS Hockey · Former Professional Hockey Player (ECHL)

name: Derrick Laporte
playingHistory: University of Windsor Lancers (U SPORTS), goaltender
Junior hockey: Lakeshore Canadiens and Essex 73's
bio: Derrick believes long-term development starts with understanding how each goaltender learns. A classroom teacher and Hockey Canada certified Level 3 goaltending coach, he draws on his junior hockey coaching experience to help each Southwest Wildcats U22 Elite goalie set individual goals. Through on-ice training and video review, goalies refine their movement, puckhandling and rebound control while learning to evaluate their own play and take ownership of their progress.
